Package org.krmdemo.plansinstr.equilib

Class SvgRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.krmdemo.plansinstr.equilib.SvgRenderer
public final class SvgRenderer extends Object
Draws the swept amount per current balance as one SVG that needs no JavaScript.

This class does the geometry and builds a model: layers of plain shapes (line, rect, circle, path, text), each a map of its attributes. The markup is the Thymeleaf template templates/equilib.svg, rendered by SvgTemplate. Maps rather than records, because Thymeleaf's expressions (OGNL) read map keys directly.

Besides the static picture, the model has a finite number of frames: one per sampled current balance. A frame is a thin transparent vertical strip around its balance and, hidden until the mouse is over that strip, the purple probe, the status line on top and the highlight of its row of the formula. CSS :hover does the rest, so only the frame under the mouse is shown; with the mouse elsewhere, the default frame is.

    • render

      public static String render(Sweep sweep)
      The adaptive picture: one SVG that looks like an icon when shown small and like the full graph, with its frames, when shown large. Its own CSS media queries pick the tier by the width the SVG is shown at (in <img>, <object> or opened directly; inline in HTML the page's width counts instead): below 80 px the small cart icon, below 200 px the icon with the $ in the cart, below 340 px the coloured slices only, below 540 px S, below 740 px M, from 740 px L. Its natural size is that of L.
      Parameters:
      sweep - the parameters (use Sweep.snapped() for a finite set of pictures)
